subject: Vendor Portal first-mile: onboarding timeline & proof custody
messages:
From: Claire Hartwell <security@hartwelltech.com>
To: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Cc: Marco Diaz <procurement@hartwelltech.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 15:22:00 -0700
Subject: Vendor onboarding request — SIG / CAIQ / SOC2 artifacts

Hi Jordan,

Thanks for the intro via Marco. Hartwell Tech is starting a formal security review ahead of procurement and we'd like to onboard Redwood into our portal so our security team can request SIG/CAIQ answers and SOC2 evidence. Our security contact is me (Claire) and procurement is Marco (cc'd).

Can Redwood accept a Vendr/Whistic-style portal invite? If so, we can send the SIG and a short CAIQ subset — the initial ask will be for network diagrams, TLS cert chains, KMS rotation evidence, and SOC2 control artifact snapshots. I attached the formal request (Hartwell_Tech_SIG_Request_v1.pdf) for reference.

High-level asks from our side:
- Portal access for read/upload (preferred: Vendr)
- Primary evidence owner for each artifact (to speed review)
- Initial ETA: 10 business days for a first pass evidence bundle

Proposed kickoff window: Thu/Fri this week for a 30-min sync to agree owners and upload flow.

Thanks — let me know availability and whether you prefer OneTrust/Whistic/Vendr.

Claire Hartwell
Head of Security, Hartwell Tech
Attachment: Hartwell_Tech_SIG_Request_v1.pdf
From: Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Hartwell <security@hartwelltech.com>
Cc: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 16:03:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding request — SIG / CAIQ / SOC2 artifacts

Claire — thanks for the clear ask and the attachment. We can absolutely take the review via Vendr (preferred for evidence attachments) but can adapt to Whistic if that's easier for you.

Quick plan (proposed):
1) We send a Vendr invite to security@hartwelltech.com and procurement contact.
2) Redwood provides a compact evidence manifest (attached) that maps requested artifacts -> team owner -> expected upload filename.
3) Internal owners (Infra / App / Privacy) have a 10 business day window for first-pass artifacts; follow-ups for missing items after that.

Can you do Thu 9/16 at 11:00 PT for a 30-min kickoff? If not, suggest two alternate times and we'll accommodate.

Attached: redwood-evidence-manifest-template.csv (fills mapping of artifact -> owner -> notes).

I'll loop Kimberly for evidence ownership and Ben for technical artifact sources (KMS, certs).

Best,
Jordan Blake
Solutions Engineer, Redwood Inference
Attachment: redwood-evidence-manifest-template.csv

From: Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>

Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding request — SIG / CAIQ / SOC2 artifacts

Claire / Jordan — looping in my notes on evidence ownership so the portal reviewers have a single point of contact per artifact.

Suggested artifact ownership (initial):
- Network diagrams / VPC ingress controls: infra_team@redwoodinference.com (Infra Lead)
- TLS cert chain + rotation notes: infra_team@redwoodinference.com
- KMS key rotation policy + snapshot: security_ops@redwoodinference.com (I own coordination)
- SOC2 control narratives (user access / change mgmt): controls@redwoodinference.com (me)
- Data retention / privacy mappings: privacy@redwoodinference.com

Timeline expectations:
- We will populate the manifest and aim to upload first-pass artifacts within 7 business days after portal invite (accelerated from 10 days where feasible).
- If Hartwell needs the SOC2 cover letter or a scoped CAIQ subset sooner, we can surface those within 48 hours.

Operational notes:
- Please include expected file naming conventions in the portal (we prefer: vendorname_artifacttype_v1.pdf).
- If you enable API-based evidence push (Vendr API), we can automate presigned S3 uploads for larger artifacts.

Kimberly Park
Security Controls Manager, Redwood Inference
Redwood Inference

From: Ben Carter <ben.carter@redwoodinference.com>
To: Claire Hartwell <security@hartwelltech.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly.park@redwoodinference.com>, Jordan Blake <jordan.blake@redwoodinference.com>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Vendor onboarding request — SIG / CAIQ / SOC2 artifacts

Quick technical clarifications for Hartwell's security team:
- KMS evidence: we can provide a rotation snapshot and KMS key policy export. Format: text or signed PDF. Attached a sample snapshot (platform-kms-rotation-snapshot.txt).
- TLS chains: we will export the full chain for our public endpoints (pem bundle) and include the issuer/expiration notes.
- S3 presigned uploads: if Vendr provides an API, we prefer to generate presigned PUTs from our upload bucket and attach metadata with checksums.

If Hartwell has a strict CAIQ subset required, please enumerate the control IDs so we can prioritize.

Ben Carter
Platform Security, Redwood Inference
Attachment: platform-kms-rotation-snapshot.txt

Thanks, Jordan / Kimberly / Ben — this is helpful. We can accept Vendr and the timeline of 7-10 business days works for procurement. I've sent the invite to security@redwoodinference.com and procurement@redwoodinference.com; please accept the Vendr invite and we'll target Thu 9/16 11:00 PT for the kickoff.

Action items agreed:
- Hartwell will send Vendr invite link to Jordan and Kimberly (sent).
- Redwood to populate and upload manifest (redwood-evidence-manifest-template.csv).
- Kimberly to own controls narratives and coordinate KMS artifacts with Ben.

I'll be on the 11:00 PT call — looking forward to a quick sync.

Best,
Claire Hartwell
